# s1nka

> s1nka is a Product Designer who designs, builds, and ships real products — working across UX/UI and product design, with native iOS apps live on the App Store.

## About

Product Designer focused on thoughtful, intuitive, visually refined digital experiences. Combines strong visual design with user-centered thinking, and ships end-to-end: design, code, App Store release. Additional interests: programming, AI, and music production.

## Skills

- Design: product design, UX/UI, design systems, prototyping, Figma
- Build: SwiftUI, React + TypeScript, AI-assisted development
- Beyond: music production, content automation

## Selected Projects

- Annoto (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6774044198): iOS screenshot annotation app with a share extension, built in SwiftUI. Live on the App Store.
- MindWhisper (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755791263): voice-journaling app for mental wellbeing with AI-powered reflections. Live on the App Store.
- Decision Engine AI (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760727264): native SwiftUI app for structured, AI-assisted decision making. Live on the App Store.
- Brain Snacks: bite-size learning feed for iOS.
